source React 19.3.1 (react-dom 19.3.1) on jsdom 30.1.3, run by tools/oracle with the harness catalog
seed 1
compare records dump=n node=depth,label,tag,props text=depth,value
requirement R1 useState(initial) returns [state, setState]; the first render shows the initial value
requirement R2 A setter call (an updater function) re-renders the component and the page shows the new state
requirement R3 Every component instance has state of its own
requirement R4 Several useState calls in one component keep separate slots, in call order, and slots never leak between components
requirement R5 Several updater calls before the next render are all applied, in the order they were called
requirement R6 State survives a re-render that comes from above or from another component
requirement R7 State belongs to the fiber at a position (or key): a new type or a new position starts from the initial value
requirement R8 A setter from an earlier render still works: nothing is lost when it is called later
requirement R9 A component whose root tag changes keeps its state, and its new nodes are live
requirement E2E Long sessions that mix all of the above
